text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Is that true? Did you really become paralyzed by eating a poisonous
mushroom, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君、
毒キノコを食べて倒れたの！？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
He really took me by surprise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんですよ～
あの時は
とっても驚いたわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Yet even though his limbs were still numb from the poison,
he tried to stand up and protect me when a little monster came
to say hello.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど、
まだ毒キノコの痺れが残ってるのに、
そこに来た魔物ちゃんから
私を守ろうと立ち上がったの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: He did that?
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなことが……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Miss Io, how did you and {0} meet?
text_block_list.orig_text:
イオ先生は、
{0}君とどう知り合いに？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Well... He came to my rescue when I got tangled up in some monster
vines in the forest.
It's not as bad as a poisonous mushroom, but it sure was embarrassing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は……
森で植物に絡まってるところを
助けてもらったんです。
毒キノコほどじゃないけど、
私も恥ずかしいわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my. It seems you've always been kindhearted.
What a good boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
やっぱり{0}君は、
ずーっと優しい心を持っていたのね～
よしよし、
いい子～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: The next time we met, he was reading books far too easy for someone his age, and that's when I found out he had amnesia. So I suggested that he enroll at Lucent Academy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
次に会った時、
彼の年頃じゃ必要ないような読み書きの本を読んでいて、
その時に初めて
記憶喪失だって知ったんです。
それで
ルーセント学院に通うように薦めたんです。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
At first, he couldn't solve even the simplest of problems,
but in no time at all, he became so reliable.
{0} is absolutely full of surprises.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はじめは簡単な問題も解けなかったけど、
いつの間にかとっても頼もしくなってきて、
{0}君には驚かされてばかりだわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I really hope he grows up to be as kind as he is now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
優しいまま
成長してほしいですよね～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wish that for him as well.
I really hope to see him flourish at Lucent Academy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
私もそれを願っています。
ルーセント学院でどんどん成長してほしいな。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right, you'll graduate from the academy one day,
won't you, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そっか、
{0}君もいつか
学院を卒業するんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Yes, he will.
And he'll become a wonderful adult who doesn't need us anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ
そうですね。
私たちが必要ないくらい、
きっと立派な大人になりますよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
But if... {0} gets his memory back today
and doesn't need the academy anymore…
text_block_list.orig_text:
もし……
今日、
ここで{0}君の記憶が戻って、
学院に通う必要がないことが分かったら……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
No doubt it will be sad, but sending students out into the world
is also part of our job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
寂しいけど、
送り出すことも
私たちの仕事ですから。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I've only recently been assigned to my role, so I haven't sent out any
students yet.
But to have {0} be the first to go...
choice_data_list: Even if I graduate, you two will always be my teachers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私
まだ赴任したばかりだから
送り出した生徒がいなくて。
初めてが
{0}君だなんて……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...{0}!
You're right. Even after you graduate,
our student-teacher bond will never change.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……{0}君！
そうよね、
君が私たちの生徒だったってことは、
卒業してもなくならない絆だもんね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'll educate you to the best of my ability so that when the time comes,
I'll be able to send you out into the world without any regrets.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつ君を送り出すことになっても後悔しないように、
それまで精一杯の教育をするからね！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear!
I'd best up my teaching game so that I won't be beaten!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら！
私も負けないように
頑張っていろんなことを教えていくわ～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
M-Miss Misato?
Why do you need to hug him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミ、
ミサト先生っ？
どうして抱きしめる必要が？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh? I do this with all the children.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
子どもたちにはみんな
こう接しているのよ～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}... Could you possibly tell me...
what the elven nursery school is like...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ{0}君……
先生に教えてくれるかしら……？
エルフの保育園って、
一体どんなところなの……？
